rewrite:
def get_safety_version() ->str:
    from importlib.metadata import version
    return version('safety')

def build_telemetry_data(telemetry: bool=True, command: Optional[str]=None,
    subcommand: Optional[str]=None) ->TelemetryModel:
    from safety_schemas.models import TelemetryModel
    
    safety_command = command if command else SafetyContext().command
    safety_subcommand = subcommand if subcommand else SafetyContext().subcommand
    
    return TelemetryModel(
        telemetry=telemetry,
        safety_version=get_safety_version(),
        python_version=platform.python_version(),
        os_type=platform.system(),
        os_release=platform.release(),
        os_description=platform.platform(),
        command=safety_command,
        subcommand=safety_subcommand,
    )
